title: Dry Seven-Cup Lotus Seedhead
description: One whole static stylized wetland dry lotus seedhead on its continuous bent stalk. A broad uneven circular top contains seven real blind seed cups sunk into one connected closed obconical receptacle; tapered side body narrows to the solid stalk attachment. The seven cups are cavities in the same mesh, not painted spots or separate bowls. New complete receptacle and stalk are authored from scratch, not a waterlily leaf, pea valve or sunflower disc stripped of petals. One prop, zero scenes or separately counted holes; no exact species, scientific seed count, animation, growth, wind or ecological function claim.
